entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:1
segments: ¶The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:2
segments: "Vanity of vanities," says the Preacher; "Vanity of vanities, all [is] vanity."

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:3
segments: What profit has a man from all his labor In which he toils under the sun?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:4
segments: ¶[One] generation passes away, and [another] generation comes; But the earth abides forever.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:5
segments: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, And hastens to the place where it arose.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:6
segments: The wind goes toward the south, And turns around to the north; The wind whirls about continually, And comes again on its circuit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:7
segments: All the rivers run into the sea, Yet the sea [is] not full; To the place from which the rivers come, There they return again.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:8
segments: All things [are] full of labor; Man cannot express [it]. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, Nor the ear filled with hearing.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:9
segments: ¶That which has been [is] what will be, That which [is] done is what will be done, And [there is] nothing new under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:10
segments: Is there anything of which it may be said, "See, this [is] new"? It has already been in ancient times before us.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:11
segments: [There is] no remembrance of former [things], Nor will there be any remembrance of [things] that are to come By [those] who will come after.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:12
segments: ¶I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:13
segments: And I set my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under heaven; this burdensome task God has given to the sons of man, by which they may be exercised.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:14
segments: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and indeed, all [is] vanity and grasping for the wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:15
segments: [What is] crooked cannot be made straight, And what is lacking cannot be numbered.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:16
segments: I communed with my heart, saying, "Look, I have attained greatness, and have gained more wisdom than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My heart has understood great wisdom and knowledge."

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:17
segments: And I set my heart to know wisdom and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also is grasping for the wind.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 1:18
segments: For in much wisdom [is] much grief, And he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.
